{
  "sop_id": "SOP-016",
  "title": "Expense Claims",
  "steps": [
    {"step_id": "S1", "name": "Open ticket and assign to self", "role": "Executor", "type": "intake"},
    {"step_id": "S2", "name": "Check each line against policy limit", "role": "Executor", "type": "work"},
    {"step_id": "S3", "name": "Match each line to a receipt", "role": "Executor", "type": "work"},
    {"step_id": "S4", "name": "Determine reimbursable amount", "role": "Executor", "type": "work"},
    {"step_id": "S5", "name": "Submit claim", "role": "Executor", "type": "work"},
    {"step_id": "A1", "name": "Incharge approval", "role": "Incharge", "type": "approval"},
    {"step_id": "R1", "name": "Rework: correct and resubmit", "role": "Executor", "type": "rework"},
    {"step_id": "A2", "name": "Lead approval (over-limit or above ₹50,000)", "role": "Lead", "type": "approval"},
    {"step_id": "D1", "name": "Receipt or clarification missing", "role": "System", "type": "decision"},
    {"step_id": "D2", "name": "Amount mismatch", "role": "System", "type": "decision"},
    {"step_id": "D3", "name": "Wrong quantity", "role": "System", "type": "decision"},
    {"step_id": "D4", "name": "Incorrect category", "role": "System", "type": "decision"},
    {"step_id": "D5", "name": "Lost receipt under ₹500", "role": "System", "type": "decision"}
  ],
  "approvals": [
    {"stage": "Incharge", "condition": "always"},
    {"stage": "Lead", "condition": "over-limit or above ₹50,000"}
  ],
  "dependencies": [],
  "rework_reasons": ["Required document missing", "Amount mismatch", "Wrong quantity", "Incorrect category"],
  "first_pass_yield_target": 0.95
}
